ov: إمبراطورية ميم واحد من كلاسيكيات السينما المصرية للمخرج حسين كمال وهو إنتاج عام 1972.
plotEn: Empire M (Arabic: إمبراطورية ميم, translit. Emberatoriet meem) is a 1972 Egyptian drama film directed by Hussein Kamal. The film was entered into the 8th Moscow International Film Festival in 1973. It was also selected as the Egyptian entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 46th Academy Awards, but was not accepted as a nominee. The film was remade in a Turkish as Benim Altı Sevgilim in 1977.
